# EcclesiaOS v1.0.45

## Release summary

EcclesiaOS v1.0.45 improves Leadership Report routing across the church and introduces explicit, production-safe access control for AI Copilot.

## Improvements

- Users with Leadership Report access can select administrator-approved reviewers from any campus, department, or ministry in their church.
- Default Reviewer and new-report Reviewer searches now share the same church-wide eligible-role policy.
- Existing campus, ministry, role, and church isolation rules remain enforced.
- Added the dedicated `use ai copilot` permission to Roles & Permissions.
- AI Copilot routes, navigation, top bar, global search, dashboard shortcuts, and Leadership Reports now consistently honor the dedicated permission.

## Database and deployment

- Adds a production migration that creates the AI Copilot permission when missing.
- Existing roles that previously received implicit Copilot access are granted the new permission automatically during upgrade.
- The standard EcclesiaOS updater runs the migration automatically with no manual database work required.

## Verification

- Full application suite passed: 281 tests and 3,157 assertions.
- Cross-campus reviewer selection, role exclusions, AI Copilot authorization, navigation, and production migration regressions passed.
- Laravel Pint, Blade template compilation, and migration readiness checks passed.
